{
  "findings": [
    {
      "page": 106,
      "where": "Exercice 8.8.7 a), définition de L_\\circ(x)",
      "scan": "L_\\circ(x) des y\\in A tels que y\\leq x",
      "tex": "$L_\\circ(x)$ des $y\\in A$ tels que $y\\leq x$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "$L_\\circ(x)$ des $y\\in C$ tels que $y\\leq x$",
      "note": "The ambient set must be C; A is not fixed in this definition. TeX keeps the printed A."
    },
    {
      "page": 106,
      "where": "Exercice 8.8.7 a), injectivité",
      "scan": "Montrer que L est une application injective",
      "tex": "que $L$ est une application injective",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "Montrer que $L_\\circ$ est une application injective",
      "note": "The map just defined is L_\\circ, distinguished from the canonical functor L on the next page. TeX keeps the missing subscript."
    },
    {
      "page": 107,
      "where": "Exercice 8.8.7 b), catégorie de restriction",
      "scan": "I_{/i_\\circ}",
      "tex": "I_{/i_\\circ}",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "I_{i_\\circ/}",
      "note": "Eventual constancy requires restriction to objects receiving an arrow from i_\\circ, not objects mapping to it. TeX keeps the reversed slice notation."
    },
    {
      "page": 107,
      "where": "Exercice 8.8.7 c), identification de C tilde",
      "scan": "C^{\\sim} est isomorphe à \\NN^\\circ\\times\\NN^{\\sim}",
      "tex": "$C^{\\widetilde{\\phantom{,}}}$ est isomorphe à $\\NN^\\circ\\times\n\\NN^{\\widetilde{\\phantom{,}}}$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "C^{\\widetilde{\\phantom{,}}}\\simeq\\{(j,i)\\in\\NN^\\circ\\times\\NN^{\\widetilde{\\phantom{,}}}\\mid i\\geq j\\}",
      "note": "The restriction i≥j must remain after adjoining infinity. The entire product has no minimal elements, whereas C tilde has the singleton ideals generated by (n,n). TeX keeps the erroneous unrestricted product."
    },
    {
      "page": 108,
      "where": "Exercice 8.8.8, définition de X_i",
      "scan": "la partie \\Delta_{i+1}\\amalg\\Delta_i de \\NN",
      "tex": "la partie $\\Delta_{i+1}\\amalg\\Delta_i$ de $\\NN$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "la partie $\\Delta_{i+1}\\amalg\\Delta_i$ de $X$",
      "note": "This disjoint union is a subset of X=\\NN\\amalg\\NN. TeX keeps the printed \\NN."
    },
    {
      "page": 109,
      "where": "Proposition 8.9.1 c), dernière phrase",
      "scan": "ce même type de limites projectives est représentables",
      "tex": "ce même type de limites projectives est\nreprésentables",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "ce même type de limites projectives est représentable",
      "note": "The adjective must agree with singular « type ». TeX keeps the printed extra s."
    },
    {
      "page": 109,
      "where": "Proposition 8.9.1 d)",
      "scan": "sont exacts à gauche",
      "tex": "sont exacts à\ngauche",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "sont exactes à gauche",
      "note": "The subject is « les petites limites inductives filtrantes ». TeX keeps the printed masculine agreement."
    },
    {
      "page": 109,
      "where": "Démonstration a), après « fait de F une »",
      "scan": "limite projective des F_j",
      "tex": "limite projective des $F_i$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "medium",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "limite projective des $F_i$",
      "note": "The isolated printed subscript j is inconsistent with the family indexed by i∈I throughout the paragraph. TeX silently regularizes it to i."
    },
    {
      "page": 109,
      "where": "Démonstration a), systèmes d’applications ensemblistes",
      "scan": "les système projectifs d'applications ensemblistes",
      "tex": "systèmes projectifs d'applications ensemblistes",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "les systèmes projectifs d'applications ensemblistes",
      "note": "The print omits the plural s of « systèmes »; TeX silently corrects it."
    },
    {
      "page": 109,
      "where": "Démonstration b), dernière phrase",
      "scan": "une limite projective de foncteurs exacts à gauche est exact à gauche",
      "tex": "est exact à gauche",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "est exacte à gauche",
      "note": "The adjective must agree with « une limite projective ». TeX keeps the printed missing e."
    },
    {
      "page": 110,
      "where": "Démonstration, lettres des deux premiers alinéas",
      "scan": "c) Résulte formellement ... ; d) Il est bien connu ...",
      "tex": "Les deux \\item poursuivent la numérotation en c), puis d).",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "d) Résulte formellement ... ; c) Il est bien connu ...",
      "note": "The first paragraph proves assertion d), concerning left exactness; the second proves c), concerning representability of projective limits. The printed proof letters are interchanged, and TeX keeps them."
    },
    {
      "page": 110,
      "where": "Démonstration, liste des types de limites projectives finies",
      "scan": "vide, deux points isolés, puis le diagramme à trois objets",
      "tex": "vide $, \\ldots ,",
      "kind": "formula",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "vide $, \\ldots ,",
        "new": "vide $, \\bigdot\\quad\\bigdot ,"
      },
      "note": "The middle diagram is the discrete category on two objects, not an ellipsis."
    },
    {
      "page": 110,
      "where": "Début du paragraphe « Supposons d’abord »",
      "scan": "Supposons d'abord I fini.",
      "tex": "\\emph{Supposons d'abord $I$ fini.}",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "Supposons d'abord $J$ fini.",
      "note": "The finiteness assumption concerns the diagram category J, not the filtered indexing category I. TeX keeps the printed I."
    },
    {
      "page": 110,
      "where": "Phrase précédant (8.9.1.1)",
      "scan": "la représentabilité des foncteur",
      "tex": "la représentabilité des foncteurs",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "la représentabilité des foncteurs",
      "note": "The print omits the plural s; TeX silently corrects it."
    },
    {
      "page": 110,
      "where": "Numéro du corollaire",
      "scan": "Corollaire 8.8.2",
      "tex": "Corollaire \\sisi{8.8.2}{8.9.2}",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "Corollaire 8.9.2",
      "note": "The first branch of \\sisi matches the erroneous printed number. The edition records it and supplies the correction."
    }
  ],
  "coordinator": "106: 0/2; 107: 0/2; 108: 0/1; 109: 0/5; 110: 1/4 (normal/misprint)."
}
